input.quote: (i) All paragraph headings contained in this Agreement are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: There is no insurance clause anywhere in the Agreement: a full-text search for insurance, coverage and insurer returns nothing, and General Matters (§ 20, p0135-p0147) runs from time of the essence through headings with no insurance covenant. Garman installs and converts Sparkling's data at the Authorized Locations (§ 4(a)-(b)) and its project personnel work with our operations (§ 9), so an uninsured vendor touching our data and sites is walk-away territory under this rule. We have inserted the shortest fallback-level covenant (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber and privacy USD 2,000,000) as a new § 20(j), leaving preferred-level CGL, workers' compensation and certificate mechanics for negotiation if Garman prefers that package.

proposal.summary: Insert fallback-level insurance paragraph (E&O USD 1M; cyber USD 2M) in General Matters
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance covenant even though Garman converts our data and attends our locations, so we have added our fallback position: errors and omissions cover of USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy cover of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: Garman shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
